acceptance_checks.description: ow_tp.gold.finance_billing_summary for ns=demo reproduces the six golden (currency, record_type, record_count, total_amount) rows exactly to the cent, computed from ow_tp.silver.custbill_records.
The export is a genuine CSV artifact written to the exports volume path with a deterministic name — no CSV-renamed-to-.xls masquerade.
Quarantined rescue records are excluded from gold totals; totals plus rescue attribution reconcile with silver row counts.
Delivery is observable and verifiable (export file exists in the volume, job run result records it); no silent sendmail no-op and no hardcoded stale recipients in code.

planted_anomalies.description: After the parent plants invalid records upstream, gold totals must remain equal to the golden clean totals — quarantined rows must not perturb any currency/type aggregate by even one cent.

planted_anomalies.reason: No mail transport exists in the demo workspace; delivery is verified as a volume artifact plus job run record instead of an SMTP round-trip.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Reads typed silver Delta columns, not raw bytes; the export CSV is written UTF-8 with LF line endings and no BOM to match the golden CSV bytes.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: not applicable upstream of silver typing; export must be deterministic bytes

malformed_record_policy.details: Silver rows with NULL currency, record_type, or amount must never be aggregated into a plausible-looking total; their presence for the target ns fails the run with attribution (they indicate an upstream contract breach).

empty_input_semantics.details: Zero silver rows for the ns/date produces a header-only export and zero gold rows for that run key, replacing nothing else; prior dates' outputs are untouched.
